summary: 73-year-old Greda Machuga of Westminster was found alive ~10:00 am 2023-08-05 near Alsbury Reservoir in the White River National Forest after a 3-day multi-agency search; she had been reported missing by family members after failing to return from an outing on 8/2/2023; she was evaluated and transported out of the area
location: White River National Forest near Alsbury Reservoir
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff Office; Mesa County SAR (assisted by Arapahoe Rescue Patrol, Aspen Mountain Rescue, Montrose County Sheriff Posse, Garfield County SAR, Garfield County Sheriff Office, Mesa County Road and Bridge, Colorado Division of Fire Prevention and Control)
notes: MCSO CrimeWatch release parent-opened run 633. Fills thin year 2023 for Mesa (zero-row year). Found 2023-08-05 (Saturday).
